build_albedo_dataset: build an AlbedoDataset instance to load real and synthetic albedo images from a data root directory
load_data_list_albedo: load the AlbedoDataset data list with optional gzip caching for real and synthetic image pairs
get_data_info_albedo: get data info for a sample index including RGB image, albedo, mask, and bounding box
process_camera_dir: process a camera directory to find matching frame files with ground truth, render, and albedo images
review_albedo_dataset_class: review the AlbedoDataset class and its load_data_list and get_data_info methods for dataset integration
